pages.lesson:
LESSON: HISTORICAL DEVELOPMENT OF AGRICULTURE

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Natural and Historic Built Environments in Africa
Topic 4.2: Historical Development of Agriculture

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Historical Development of Agriculture. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why did people start practising agriculture in Africa?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. locate areas where early agriculture was practised in selected geographical regions in Africa
2. explore factors that favoured growing of crops and rearing of animals in selected regions during early agriculture
3. assess the contributions of the Nile Valley agriculture to the world civilisation

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. locate areas where early agriculture was practised in selected geographical regions in Africa
   In simple words: practise until you can locate areas where early agriculture was practised in selected geographical regions in Africa. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. explore factors that favoured growing of crops and rearing of animals in selected regions during early agriculture
   In simple words: practise until you can explore factors that favoured growing of crops and rearing of animals in selected regions during early agriculture. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. assess the contributions of the Nile Valley agriculture to the world civilisation
   In simple words: practise until you can assess the contributions of the Nile Valley agriculture to the world civilisation. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Historical Development of Agriculture using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Historical Development of Agriculture in the examples.
2. Explain Historical Development of Agriculture to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Historical Development of Agriculture.
4. Show that you can: locate areas where early agriculture was practised in selected geographical regions in Africa

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Historical Development of Agriculture using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Historical Development of Agriculture important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Use digital devices/ other sources to draw the map of Africa and show areas where early agriculture was practised in selected geographical regions. (Rift Valley of Eastern Africa, Egypt, and Nubia),
2. Discuss the contribution of the Nile Valley agriculture to the world civilisation,

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why did people start practising agriculture in Africa?
2. How did Agriculture begin in Africa?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. locate areas where early agriculture was practised in selected geographical regions in Africa
2. explore factors that favoured growing of crops and rearing of animals in selected regions during early agriculture
3. assess the contributions of the Nile Valley agriculture to the world civilisation

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
